this_rebuild.binary_self_tests: Linux binary on Fedora 44 and Windows binary under Wine: 62 tests pass each
this_rebuild.manual_check: Full four-stage sessions with 30-second stages run interactively, from an earlier build of this change and from the final source

limitations: Automated tests use dummy SDL video/audio drivers and injected input events.
Native Windows hardware and audible sound were not tested.
The final executables were self-tested but not run interactively; Ubuntu 20.04/22.04 runs were not repeated for this build.
Authenticated network services were not contacted.
fixes: Correct hole, depth, column-transition and column-diversity metrics
Preserve a zero best controller score
Compare study timers against the absolute deadline
Use keyboard text for Shift, underscores and uppercase account input
Keep account text mappings separate from game controls
Map USB Gamepad B button index 2 to counterclockwise rotation
Recognize USB Gamepad B button index 2 in the configuration picker
Rename study profiles to normal, lagging, leading and prescriptive; remove practice, baseline and test profiles
Run practice, baseline and playing stages in one session with an instruction screen before each
Show each profile's aid only in the playing stage
Change the board frame color with the bar only in the lagging profile
Picker lists study profiles first, without .config, and hides default
Only Esc leaves a game; Space and controller Select no longer exit
Clear staged build assets so removed configs are not bundled
A lost game in a timed stage restarts by itself after 2.5 seconds until time runs out
Open the config picker and the game fullscreen by default; -F false runs in a window
Draw the start, settings and performance screens at their 800x600 layout and scale them to fit, so text no longer overlaps in fullscreen
Add a final 10-minute test stage on the normal display (45 minutes of play)
Stop the stage clock while a game is paused; START, Enter or P pauses and resumes
Home screen has only a participant ID field and PLAY; save files are named <ID>_<date>_<time>
Ignore input left over from the config picker
Paste the participant ID with Ctrl+V, Cmd+V or Shift+Insert
Blink a vertical bar in the participant ID field
Four scripted instruction screens before practice and scripted screens before each later stage, with the arm's panel before the playing stage
Instruction screens move on only with START (Enter); Esc returns to the home screen
Instruction text is larger, one sentence per line, in a narrower column that shrinks to fit the screen
Show the time left in the current stage in the bottom right corner
At the end of a session, START (Enter) opens the config picker for the next participant and Esc closes the game, instead of freezing
